description_en: Modifies the cross-region backup settings of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS跨地域备份设置
name: ModifyInstanceCrossBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the source instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 源实例地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The retention type of cross-region backups. Only 1 is supported, which indicates that all backups are retained
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份保存类型。当前唯一取值：1，表示每个备份都保存
parameters.name: cross_backup_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cross-region log backup. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled

You can configure this parameter only when the overall cross-region backup feature is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域日志备份开关，取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

跨地域备份总开关开启时，才能设置日志开关
parameters.name: log_backup_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the overall cross-region backup feature, which includes data backup and log backup. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled

When you enable cross-region backup, you must specify the destination region ID
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份总开关（数据备份+日志备份），取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

开启跨地域备份时，必须传入目的地域ID
parameters.name: backup_enabled

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID
parameters.name: cross_backup_region

parameters.help_en: The retention method for cross-region backups. Only 1 is supported, which indicates that backups are retained based on a specified retention period
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份保留方式。当前唯一取值：1，表示按时长保留
parameters.name: retent_type

parameters.help_en: The retention period of cross-region backups. Valid values: 7 to 1825. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份保留天数，取值：7~1825
parameters.name: retention

BackupEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the overall cross-region backup feature is enabled. Valid values:
Disable: The feature is disabled.
Enable: The feature is enabled
BackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域备份总开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: The ID of the destination region for cross-region backup
CrossBackupRegion.description_zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID

CrossBackupType.description_en: The retention type of cross-region backups. Default value: 1, which indicates that all backups are retained
CrossBackupType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保存类型。默认值：1，表示每个备份都保存

LogBackupEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether cross-region log backup is enabled. Valid values:
Disable: Cross-region log backup is disabled.
Enable: Cross-region log backup is enabled
LogBackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域日志备份开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the source instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html） operation to query region IDs
RegionId.description_zh: 源实例地域ID，可以通过接口[DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html）查看地域ID

RetentType.description_en: The retention method for cross-region backups. Default value: 1, which indicates that backups are retained based on a specified retention period
RetentType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留方式。默认值：1，表示按时长保留

Retention.description_en: The retention period of cross-region backups. Valid values: 7 to 1825. Unit: days
Retention.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留天数，取值：7~1825
